introduction: Texas SNAP applications use Your Texas Benefits or a paper H1010 form. Explain who purchases and prepares food together so HHS can assess the correct household.
description: Texas SNAP applications use Your Texas Benefits or a paper H1010 form. Explain who purchases and prepares food together so HHS can assess the correct household.

sections.who: HHS reviews household finances and program conditions. Required household members can affect the application even if food arrangements differ.
sections.get: Approved food benefits are issued on a Lone Star Card.
sections.docs:
• Income and household information.
  • Identity and residence evidence.
  • Requested expense and resource verification.
sections.apply:
1. Submit an application

    Use Your Texas Benefits or request H1010 through HHS.

  2. Complete requested review

    Answer interview and verification requests.

  3. Read the notice

    Check the decision and case-reporting instructions.
sections.after: Keep submission confirmation and respond to HHS messages. Review renewal dates on your case notice.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using SNAP household policy, Application methods, Lone Star benefit description. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Must an interview happen before filing?
HHS policy allows filing before the interview.
HHS lists office, mail and fax submission as alternatives to online intake.
Food purchasing and preparation matter, but mandatory-member rules also apply.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
